### Meaning
| infl. | class | meaning                                                                     |
| ----- | ----- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ~     | *n.*  | crystal, glass;<br>hard brittle see-through/reflective material that clinks |
### Implied meaning
- clink, chime, jingle
- transparent, clear
- brittle, fragile
### Etymology
#### Glyph
simple pictograph of a cluster of crystals
#### Sound
- *a priori:* ch=sharp, in=sharp
- *imitative of:* the clinking sound of glass
- "cincin", Italian onomatopoeia for glass clinking
- Related to [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Nature/chu\|Sen'fi/Glossary/Nature/chu]] (snow, which is just water crystals)
